source.title: Kobiconn154-2442-E, KC-301021, revised2006-07-19
source.retrieved: User downloaded in browser; preserved byte-for-byte from Downloads/KC-301021.pdf

source_interpretation: The 0.38 dimension is the body standoff, not shell gauge. The 2006 user-supplied BOM drawing supersedes the mixed-source projection lengths in the former model.
geometry_changes: Lift original body and cavity 0.38mm above PCB datum
Retain all original XY terminal axes and body XY envelope
Extend signal terminals to 2.91mm and board locks to3.72mm below PCB
Provide illustrative shell clearances and insulating exit skirts; remove old signal-pin/shell intersections
Add four illustrative gold-plated mating strips
preserved: All PCB copper, pads, holes, footprint placements and model transforms
All1681 Blender object identities, poses, cameras, animation, existing shaders and case geometry
Original Eagle and previous saved Blender scenes
limitations: Independent drawing-derived illustration, not manufacturer CAD or identification of the physically fitted connector.
Body standoff and terminal projections follow the2006 BOM part drawing; original XY axes, body envelope and mating cavity are preserved.
Signal stock0.40mm square, board-lock width2.4mm/thickness0.30mm/fork shape, shell gauge, insulating exit skirts and gold-strip dimensions remain illustrative.
Hidden internal contact routing, stamped spring features and exact mould/retention geometry are not reconstructed.
Nominal board-lock interference remains documented; no PCB hole, copper, placement or tolerance change.
electrical_note: Fresh ERC0 under retained rules; existing three missing connections, DRC warnings and schematic parity warnings persist.
